captions_note: the reel's captions stay still over the move
in_a_reel: one slot per cut, across the cut, about 0.5 s each side. Choose MOVE by name; a second cut takes a second slot (--name)
a cut in the middle of a word fights the move: use a cut in a gap between words where you can
steps: edit MOVE in the CLIP block
run build.py SAFE=1      # bakes assets/plate.mp4, prints the frames and the snapshot list
run check.py      # frame count, work/check/sheet.jpg, phone copy
